answer_1.quote: The goal of this work is to train a generator (G) that can produce a tutor's utterance u′i that matches a given hedge strategy (i.e., hedge or non-hedge) li, according to the dialogue history hi.
answer_1.outputs: Tutor utterances with hedge or non-hedge strategy

answer_2.quote: To evaluate performance, we used the most widely used set of reference-based metrics for natural language generation tasks ... we add an unsupervised reference-free metric, the BART score.

answer_4.quote: We therefore asked two annotators to ignore sub-categories and annotate only hedge or non-hedge on each tutor turn of the model's output, with access to 4 prior turns of the dialogue history.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators labeled each tutor turn as hedge or non-hedge and noted if the output was unnatural.
